map.依据内膜厚度与回声类型(三线征)评估胚胎移植窗口期容受性: Evaluates endometrial receptivity in the embryo-transfer window by endometrial thickness and echo pattern (triple-line sign)
map.子宫内膜容受性按厚度与回声类型判定：C 型强回声容受性差；厚度 小于6mm 过薄: Endometrial receptivity is judged by thickness and echo type: type C hyperechoic has poor receptivity; thickness <6mm too thin, 6–7mm borderline thin, 7–14mm with type A triple-line is good receptivity, type B is borderline; combine with cycle day to determine the transfer window.
map.评估过厚风险: Assess risk of being too thick
map.不建议当周期移植: Not recommended for transfer in this cycle
map.：强-弱-强三层，外层与中央强回声，中间低回声，提示增殖期: : strong-weak-strong three layers, outer and central hyperechoic, middle hypoechoic, suggesting proliferative phase
map.：三线征模糊，内膜与肌层等回声: : blurred triple-line, endometrium isoechoic with myometrium
map.最佳移植窗口：内膜 8-12mm + A型三线征: Optimal transfer window: endometrium 8-12mm + Type A triple-line
map.提示：ERA(内膜容受性检测)可更精确判断移植窗口。薄型内膜可尝试雌激素、阿司匹: Note: ERA (endometrial receptivity array) can more precisely judge the transfer window. Thin endometrium may try estrogen, aspirin, G-CSF and other improvement plans. For learning reference only.
map.移植窗口内膜条件判定。: Determining endometrial conditions in the transfer window.
map.增殖期 A 型三线征且厚度 7–14mm → 良好容受，适宜移植窗口。: Proliferative-phase Type A triple-line and thickness 7–14mm → good receptivity, suitable transfer window.
map.偏薄且分泌期 C 型过早出现，容受欠佳，建议调整方案或宫腔评估。: Too thin and secretory-phase Type C appearing prematurely, poor receptivity, recommend adjusting the protocol or endometrial cavity assessment.
map.通常 7–14mm 且 A 型三线征最佳；<7mm 容受下降。: Usually 7–14mm with Type A triple-line is best; <7mm receptivity declines.
map.A 增殖期三线、B 过渡、C 分泌期均质高回声，需结合周期日判读。: A proliferative triple-line, B transition, C secretory homogeneous hyperechoic; interpret with cycle day.
map.子宫内膜(厚度三线征)容受性评估器，依据内膜厚度与三线征(回声类型)评估胚胎移植: The Endometrial (Thickness Triple-Line) Receptivity Evaluator assesses endometrial receptivity in the embryo-transfer window by endometrial thickness and the triple-line sign (echo type). A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.

map.子宫内膜容受性评估器是做什么的？: What does the Endometrial Receptivity Evaluator do?
map.输入子宫内膜厚度与超声回声类型（是否呈三线征），工具评估胚胎移植窗口期的内膜容受: Enter endometrial thickness and ultrasound echo type (whether triple-line sign is present); the tool assesses endometrial receptivity in the embryo-transfer window, flags risks of being too thin or echo abnormality, and helps reproductive physicians time the optimal transfer.
